axes.description: Identifies who or what produced an observation or finding. Always explicit; absence never means agent.

terms.title: Agent
terms.description: An LLM-driven reviewer produced this record.

terms.title: Deterministic sensor
terms.description: A non-model tool or analyzer produced this record.

terms.title: Human
terms.description: A human reviewer or operator produced this record.

terms.title: Imported
terms.description: This record was migrated from a legacy contract without re-derivation.

terms.title: Unknown
terms.description: The producer could not be determined and must not be assumed.

axes.description: Describes evidence coverage only. It is not a pass or block decision.

terms.title: Available
terms.description: The evidence needed for the assessment was collected.

terms.title: Partial
terms.description: Some but not all expected evidence was collected.

terms.title: Unavailable
terms.description: No usable evidence was collected.

axes.description: Describes what the evidence establishes for a review or aspect.

terms.title: Pass
terms.description: The evidence establishes conformance.

terms.title: Concern
terms.description: The evidence raises a qualified concern short of failure.

terms.title: Fail
terms.description: The evidence establishes non-conformance.

terms.title: Inconclusive
terms.description: The evidence collected does not support a determination.

terms.title: Not applicable
terms.description: The aspect does not apply to this subject.

terms.title: Not assessed
terms.description: The aspect was not evaluated in this observation.

terms.title: Improved
terms.description: The change made this aspect better.

terms.title: Regressed
terms.description: The change made this aspect worse.

terms.title: Mixed
terms.description: The change improved some evidence and regressed other evidence.

terms.title: Unchanged
terms.description: The change left this aspect the same.

terms.title: No observed delta
terms.description: No comparable prior observation exists.

terms.title: Inconclusive
terms.description: The comparison evidence does not support a determination.

axes.description: Optional policy output with a required policyRef. Never supplied by a raw finding.

terms.title: Allow
terms.description: Policy permits proceeding.

terms.title: Warn
terms.description: Policy flags a concern but does not block.

terms.title: Block
terms.description: Policy prevents proceeding.

terms.title: Defer
terms.description: Policy defers the decision to a later or human review.

axes.description: Retains current ordering and meaning; scoring weights stay in policy.

terms.title: Critical
terms.description: Immediate, severe impact.

terms.title: High
terms.description: Significant impact.

terms.title: Medium
terms.description: Moderate impact.

terms.title: Low
terms.description: Limited impact.

terms.title: Info
terms.description: Informational only.

axes.description: Lives in lifecycle events, not observations.

terms.title: Open
terms.description: The issue is open and unresolved.

terms.title: Accepted risk
terms.description: The issue is acknowledged and accepted.

terms.title: Waived
terms.description: The issue is waived under a documented exception.

terms.title: False positive
terms.description: The issue does not represent a real defect.

terms.title: Resolved
terms.description: The issue has been fixed.

axes.description: Each item has a locator or artifact reference, summary, and digest when content is available.

terms.title: Source code
terms.description: Evidence drawn directly from source code.

terms.title: Test result
terms.description: Evidence drawn from a test execution.

terms.title: Runtime measurement
terms.description: Evidence drawn from observed runtime behavior.

terms.title: Tool result
terms.description: Structured machine output from a deterministic tool.

terms.title: Artifact
terms.description: A referenced build or repository artifact.

terms.title: Document
terms.description: Freeform textual evidence, such as prose review commentary.

terms.title: Human attestation
terms.description: A human statement offered as evidence.

aspects.title: Correctness
aspects.description: Functional correctness of the reviewed code.

aspects.title: Architecture
aspects.description: Structural and architectural soundness of the reviewed code.

aspects.title: Security
aspects.description: General security posture of the reviewed subject.

aspects.title: Secrets
aspects.description: Handling of credentials and secret material.

aspects.title: Input validation
aspects.description: Validation and sanitization of untrusted input.

aspects.title: Configuration and infrastructure as code
aspects.description: Security of configuration and infrastructure-as-code artifacts.

aspects.title: Boundary exposure
aspects.description: Exposure and hardening of external-facing boundaries.

aspects.title: Business logic abuse
aspects.description: Resistance of business logic to abuse and bypass, as assessed by deep-flow review.

aspects.title: Attack coverage
aspects.description: Coverage of catalogued attack scenarios against boundaries.

aspects.title: Performance
aspects.description: General performance characteristics of the reviewed subject.

aspects.title: Change risk
aspects.description: Overall risk introduced by a change.

aspects.title: Change test evidence
aspects.description: Adequacy of test evidence accompanying a change.

aspects.title: Change scope discipline
aspects.description: Whether a change stays within its intended scope.

aspects.title: Change architecture drift
aspects.description: Architectural drift introduced by a change.
